versions.changelog:
Initial release of the auth0-migration skill.

- Provides step-by-step guidance for migrating from various auth providers (Firebase, Cognito, Supabase, Clerk, custom) to Auth0.
- Covers both bulk and gradual (lazy) migration strategies, including hybrid approaches.
- Includes instructions on exporting users, importing to Auth0, and updating application code.
- Details JWT validation updates needed for APIs switching to Auth0.
- Lists common migration issues and solutions.
- Offers references and code migration patterns for major frontend and backend frameworks.
